mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over the preceding 6 months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a flattening industrial production (INDPRO) series indicates weakening aggregate demand, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND INDPRO flat (monthly change < 0.1%) for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below the median market return at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7% for two consecutive months, combined with a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the same period, signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% for 2 consecutive months AND PAYEMS monthly change < -0.2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or the average return is not significantly below the market median at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp reduction in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% during a recessionary environment (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals a policy-driven liquidity expansion that boosts risk asset valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically above the median at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) of more than 5% for three consecutive months signals a recovery in residential construction demand, which historically coincides with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to correlated consumer spending and materials sector strength.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change > 5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically above zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth above 0.5% monthly for three consecutive months, accompanied by a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer purchasing power and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > 0.5% for 3 months AND UNRATE monthly change < -0.1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically above the median at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) of more than 3%, with no concurrent recovery in industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a deepening consumption-led recession that precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -3% AND INDPRO monthly change < 0% for 6 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below the median at the 5% level.
